new_results.statement: For Q=2(X0+ell.X)(g.X)+d(beta.X)^2 with beta perpendicular g, ||beta||=1, gamma=||g||, and leaf i satisfying q_i=beta_i^2+g_i^2/gamma^2<1, if ell_-i lies in span{g_-i,beta_-i}, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= [192/(|d| gamma^2 (1-q_i))]^(1/3).
With kappa=dist(ell_-i,span{g_-i,beta_-i})>0 and diffuse orthonormal residual three-frame, ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3*2^(5/3)[kappa |d| gamma^2(1-q_i)]^(-1/3).

A rank-two cap-one product family Q_c=2U(W+cV)+V^2-W^2/c^2 has unbounded density for every c>0, although its exact-zero-edge companion is bounded. This refutes small-edge perturbation with arbitrary residual quadratic remainder, not QFORM.
